title: Bind instances to exact layouts and positions
description: Bind every SheetInstance to one immutable sheet-layout revision and persist only used-position identifiers valid for that exact revision.
acceptanceCriteria: Each instance references one exact layout identity and immutable revision
Every used-position identifier validates against that revision's canonical position set
Duplicate, unknown, or out-of-range position identifiers are rejected atomically
Layout binding cannot be silently changed after creation and used positions survive reload

steps.details: Add exact SheetLayout/Revision references and a canonical set/list of used-position IDs to the versioned SheetInstance schema.
Resolve the exact immutable revision and reject duplicate, malformed, missing, or foreign position IDs before mutation.
Provide semantic keyboard-operable used/not-used controls with equivalent text for visual sheet markings.
Cover valid sparse positions, duplicates, foreign revisions, immutable binding, reload, and accessible selected-state behavior.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; add exact binding and used-position validation to the existing instance record.
Used means user-recorded consumption, not browser-observed physical state.
Store stable position identifiers rather than display indices.
